title: Tour WORTH THE WAIT Before the Miami International Boat Show
description: Skip the lines! Tour "WORTH THE WAIT," the award-winning 2024 Sunseeker Ocean 182, in Miami before the International Boat Show begins.
html:
Beyond the Crowds: Your Private Invitation to Tour WORTH THE WAIT Before MIBS

The countdown to the 85th Discover Boating Miami International Boat Show (MIBS) has officially begun. Taking place from February 11–15, 2026, this year’s event is more than just a date on the calendar; it is a total evolution of the yachting experience in Miami. With the highly anticipated return of the Yacht Collection to Collins Avenue for the first time since 2018, the energy in Miami Beach is going to be electric.

While the world waits for the gates to open, we are giving you a private “front-of-the-line” pass to a vessel that truly lives up to its name: the 2024 Sunseeker Ocean 182 “WORTH THE WAIT”.

Why WORTH THE WAIT is the Ultimate Pre-Show Tour

The Sunseeker Ocean 182 isn’t just a yacht; it’s a floating penthouse that challenges the traditional layout of a 90-foot vessel. Named for its massive 182 Gross Tonnage, this model offers significantly more interior volume than almost any other yacht in its class.

  • The Sky Lounge Revolution: Unlike a standard open flybridge, WORTH THE WAIT features a fully enclosed sky lounge. By moving the only helm station to this climate-controlled upper deck, Sunseeker has completely opened up the main deck into a massive, social “loft” space with 7-foot floor-to-ceiling windows.
  • Award-Winning Layout: This hull belongs to the series that won the prestigious “Best Layout” award at the World Yacht Trophies for its seamless indoor-outdoor flow.
  • Ready for 2026: This is a near-new 2024 delivery with an extended warranty covering all major systems through December 2028. It’s a “new-build” opportunity without the three-year waiting list.

What to Expect at MIBS 2026

If you do head to the show in February, here is the new landscape you’ll be navigating:

  • The New Three-Location Footprint: The show has streamlined into three primary hubs: the Miami Beach Convention Center, the Miami Beach Yacht Collection on Collins Avenue (yachts 30–125 ft), and Sailor’s Cove at IGY Yacht Haven Grande (superyachts and sailing).
  • Better Connectivity: A brand-new network of water taxis, electric golf cart loops, and shuttles will connect the venues to reduce travel time.
  • Enhanced Experience: The new layout is designed to reduce congestion and make it easier for serious buyers to spend more time on the water and less time in traffic.

Don’t Wait for the Crowds

The Miami International Boat Show is the perfect place to see the industry’s latest, but it can be a whirlwind. Viewing WORTH THE WAIT now means you can step aboard in peace, explore the luxurious 4-stateroom layout, and finalize your plans before the show chaos begins.

Ready to see why she’s WORTH THE WAIT? Contact us today to schedule your private tour in Miami before the show starts.
